examples.arabic: صوت المطره على الشباك كان مريح وهوا ساقع دخل من البلكونه المفتوحه
examples.english: The sound of the rain on the window was relaxing, and cold air came in from the open balcony.
examples.transliteration: sot el matara ala el shobak kan moryeh we hawa saqea dakhal men el balkona el maftouha

examples.arabic: الجارسون قعد جنبها وقال: "ده كركديه ساقع باللبن يا فندم، تحبي تِشرَبيه؟"
examples.english: The waiter sat next to her and said: "This is cold karkade with milk, madam, would you like to drink it?"
examples.transliteration: El-garsoon qa'ad gambaha we 'al: "Dah karkadeh saqe' bel-laban ya fandem, tehebbay tishrabieh?"
examples.storyTitle: A Strange Drink at Zamalek Café
